title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, bringing enhanced capabilities and a seamless experience to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management & Control
summary: Effortlessly manage your uploaded images and files with new controls for removing, downloading, and customizing their display directly within the editor.

title: Unveiling Our Public Product Roadmap!
summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap page, offering you a transparent view of our product's journey from recently completed features to exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes to be larger, easier to click, and fully draggable, making task management more intuitive and visually consistent.

title: Smarter Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with real-time updates and clear visibility into who's working on what, making collaboration effortless and efficient.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Discovery
summary: We've made it effortless to discover and collaborate on shared content with your connections, fostering a more integrated and productive collaborative environment.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the future of our platform.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: We're expanding Noeko to support a diverse range of international languages, making our platform accessible to even more users worldwide.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning Themes
summary: Get ready for a more vibrant and customized interface as we unveil refined existing themes and introduce an array of exciting new visual choices.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge Graph's Full Potential
summary: We're transforming your Constellation view into a powerful knowledge exploration tool with advanced filtering by tags and time, alongside the ability to effortlessly manage and view your shared items.

title: Precision Search and Saved Views
summary: Find precisely what you're looking for by applying powerful filters and sorting options, and save your custom search views to effortlessly revisit key information.

title: Enhanced Content Displays
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to structure your thoughts with dynamic content previews and enhanced interaction for linked notes.

title: Noeko's Public Debut: Self-Hosted Freedom & Flexible Plans
summary: We're thrilled to prepare Noeko for its public release, introducing self-hosted deployment options alongside flexible cloud-hosted plans to empower all users.

title: Personalized Time-Based Greetings
summary: Experience a more welcoming and precise interaction with our platform as we ensure greetings accurately adapt to your local time.

title: Efficiently Manage Tagged Items
summary: Streamline your workflow by easily removing multiple items from a tag directly within the list view, giving you effortless control over your content.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Gain deeper understanding by expanding your ability to import and work with a comprehensive range of content types, from online videos and websites to text documents, all within our platform.
